notices.title: TRAIL STATUS - 22nd OCTOBER 2026

notices.text:
We want to inform you that the trails Dolmen and Pianarella are closed until further notice due to a landslide on SP 27, at the trail exits.

*********************************************************************************************************************************

Please also note that SP 27 (Feglino - Finale) is closed to all traffic, including bicycles, for safety works. The road will remain closed until further notice.
